description:
AI-powered 3D globe control via MCP — 59 tools for camera, layers, entities, animation, scene, interaction, heatmap, trajectory, and geocoding with CesiumJS.

Supports stdio (Claude Desktop, VS Code Copilot, Cursor) and Streamable HTTP (Dify, n8n, custom backends) transports. Multi-browser session routing, toolset filtering, and Cesium Ion asset loading included.
